name: WBench: A Comprehensive Multi-turn Benchmark for Interactive Video World Model Evaluation

model_interfaces.text_conditioned: text prompt plus first-frame image; 289 cases
model_interfaces.camera_conditioned: first-frame image plus 6-DoF camera pose; 158 Navi cases
model_interfaces.action_conditioned: first-frame image plus discrete action; 158 Navi cases

score_semantics.navi: 158-case subset intended for camera/action navigation interfaces
score_semantics.comparison_rule: Keep each metric and interface separate; never compare text, camera and discrete-action interfaces as the same task.

current_published_submissions.evaluation_source: 16 submitter-evaluated metrics plus 3 organizer-evaluated VLM metrics
current_published_submissions.provenance_limitation: 16 submitted local metrics were aggregate-schema/count checked only; per-case local scores not provided.
Original inference sidecars were not supplied for independent reconstruction of turn boundaries.

reproduction_requirements.judge: Pin VLM judge and exact endpoint/model version. The README warns scores from different judges are not directly comparable.
reproduction_requirements.compute: GPU-heavy preprocessing includes SAM2, DA3, MegaSAM, and VLM phases; measure generation and evaluation separately.
reproduction_requirements.data: The README indicates MIT for code and data; model weights retain their original licenses. Review each model/checkpoint's original license before reproduction.
reproduction_requirements.no_composite_claims: Do not compare the mixed-provenance VWA-World score as though all 19 metrics were independently organizer evaluated.
reproduction_requirements.current_page_model_count_note: Pinned repository README describes 39 models; current public leaderboard page lists 45 entries (13 text, 21 camera, 11 action). Keep source-revision count and live page snapshot distinct.

claim_ceiling: Public leaderboard reference only. Scores have mixed self/organizer provenance and separate action/camera interfaces. No Symthaea score or SOTA claim.

live_leaderboard_snapshot.provenance_note: The table combines model interfaces; do not read overall Navi rank as an action-conditioned-only ranking. VWA-World's published report provenance records 16 submitter-evaluated metrics plus three organizer-evaluated VLM metrics.
live_leaderboard_snapshot.caveat: All-types Navi aggregate table mixes text, camera and action interfaces. It must not be presented as an action-only SOTA ranking. The page also lists some unranked entries separately; retain their status rather than assigning them a rank.

published_findings.details: The benchmark reports different models leading different dimensions; the top aggregate score is not evidence of universal superiority.
YUME 1.5 has high navigation but weak event-edit/perspective-switch scores, while Wan 2.7 has strong event/subject action but lower navigation.
Navigation accuracy and perspective consistency are separately measured and can diverge substantially.
Reported video-quality/physical-plausibility correlation rho=0.82; control ability versus physics shows near-zero correlation.
Navigation accuracy drops about 21 points from turn 1 to turn 4; dedicated geometric control degrades less than text-conditioned generation.
